usage: Positive style context only. Never copy reserved headlines verbatim.
style_principles: Open with a concrete operational contrast, not a generic SaaS benefit.
Move from physical cargo or document handoff to the record mismatch.
Introduce Example Company only after the operational problem is visible.
Use short uppercase headlines and specific operator language.
Separate stock photography, document composites, diagrams, product UI and end cards.
reserved_headlines: ONE SHIPMENT. MANY BORDERS. ONE RECORD.
THE TRUCK IS NOT THE ONLY THING MOVING.
ONE OLD PDF CAN STOP THE NEXT TEAM.
THE TRUCK MOVED. THE RECORD DID NOT.
EVERY HANDOFF NEEDS THE SAME RECORD.
AN OLD PDF BECOMES A NEW DELAY.
PUT EVERY TEAM ON THE CURRENT RECORD.

story_anatomy: physical shipment and record move at different speeds
the same shipment appears as different files across channels
multiple roles depend on one current record
the wrong version reaches a downstream handoff
documents and validation states reconnect around the cargo record
one shipment crosses several operational boundaries
each handoff adds another record dependency
a mismatch becomes visible at the next checkpoint
one cargo trail connects documents events approvals and updates
